subject: Invoice delivery and AP onboarding — portal consent + fallback
messages:
From: AP-team@novussystems.com
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: AP intake - how do you want invoices delivered?

Hi Jordan,

We are ready to send invoices for the Q4 usage period but want to confirm the preferred delivery method and any required fields. Our AP team typically automates ingestion via SFTP or e-invoice XML, but we can also email PDFs to your AP contact.

Questions:
- Do you prefer portal ingestion (SFTP/API/e-invoice) or email PDFs?
- Is a PO number required on every invoice? If so, please confirm the PO format.
- We have a VAT registration and can attach a tax certificate. Any specific evidence you need?

Attached: vendor_po_77823.pdf (contains PO reference).

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Finance Operations
Novus Systems
AP-team@novussystems.com

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: AP-team@novussystems.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-29T10:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP intake - how do you want invoices delivered?

Hi Elena / AP team,

Thanks for the note. Our preferred path is the Redwood Billing Portal (automated e-invoice ingestion). Benefits: faster processing, PO matching, and automated VAT evidence capture. We can also accept emailed PDF copies as a fallback for suppliers that can’t connect immediately.

Quick answers:
- Preferred: Portal (SFTP/API/e-invoice XML); Fallback: billing@redwood.com (PDF attachments).
- PO: yes, please include the PO number. Format: RDW-##### (we accept numeric suffixes).
- VAT evidence: a scanned tax certificate is fine; portal ingestion has a field to upload it.

I’ve looped in Marissa (billing owner) to share the onboarding checklist and Connor (AP integrations) to coordinate SFTP/API access. Marissa — can you confirm the minimal fields we need and attach the e-invoice schema? Connor — please advise on credentials/hostnames we can provide to the vendor for SFTP.

Next step for Novus: Marissa will send an invite link + schema. If they prefer email, we’ll accept a PDF copy to billing@redwood.com and process it manually.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Elena Torres <elena@novussystems.com>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com
Cc: AP-team@novussystems.com
Date: 2026-11-30T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP intake - how do you want invoices delivered?

Jordan — thanks, that sounds good. We would prefer portal onboarding to avoid manual work. A couple of clarifications before we start:

- We can do e-invoice XML but will likely begin with SFTP drop for the first month. Please confirm SFTP host, account format and sample file layout.
- VAT certificate: we can attach a combined PDF (invoice + tax cert) if that’s acceptable for your AP.
- PO: the PO from procurement is RDW-2026-77823 (will appear on our invoices).

We can aim to have test files ready by next Wednesday. Please send the onboarding link and schema and any required supplier consent/terms.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — attaching the vendor PO again.

Regards,
Elena

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: jordan.blake@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Cc: AP-team@novussystems.com
Date: 2026-11-30T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: RE: AP intake - how do you want invoices delivered? (onboarding checklist)

Jordan / Connor / Novus AP,

Here’s the minimal onboarding checklist from Billing: please share with the vendor and confirm back once each item is complete.

1) Supplier portal consent form (we’ll send DocuSign link).
2) Remit-to address on invoice (legal entity + mailing address) — required for 3-way match.
3) PO field: include RDW-2026-##### exactly as provided by procurement.
4) File format: we support e-invoice XML v2 (schema attached) and SFTP drop of PDF/E-invoice ZIP.
5) VAT evidence: upload tax_certificate.pdf in the portal; if you email, append it to the invoice PDF.

Attachments: redwood_einvoice_schema_v2.xml (schema), onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub).

Timeline suggestion: portal invite today, vendor test file by Wed 12/02, go-live (auto-processing) on 12/08 if tests pass. If vendor cannot connect, they should email sample_invoice.pdf + tax_certificate.pdf to billing@redwood.com and we will process manually within 5 business days.

Connor: please provide SFTP host/username and create a test account for novus_ap_test.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: jordan.blake@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena@novussystems.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, connor.obrien@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AP intake - how do you want invoices delivered?

Elena — thanks for confirming. I’ve completed the steps below:

- Sent DocuSign portal consent to the email you used on the PO (link: https://app.redwood.com/portal/onboard?invite=3a9b2c). Please sign so we can enable your account.
- Connor will provision an SFTP test account (novus_ap_test) and send host/credentials to AP-team@novussystems.com shortly.
- Marissa attached the e-invoice schema for your dev team and listed the required fields.
- If you prefer to start with a PDF drop, please send a sample_invoice.pdf with the tax_certificate.pdf appended to billing@redwood.com and prefix the filename with the PO (RDW-2026-77823_sample.pdf).

Target dates: test files by 2026-12-02, automated processing target 2026-12-08. If anything blocks you, reply here and we’ll keep the manual fallback active.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: sample_invoice.pdf, tax_certificate.pdf
